whatIs: AI Particle Simulator is a browser-based studio for designing 3D particle swarms with WebGL and watching them animate in real time. It comes with preset formations and post-processing effects, and lets you import images, text or 3D models as a starting point. For the AI part, it offers a prompt that you copy into an external assistant, such as Gemini or Claude, and the code it gives back runs in the tool.
It's a good fit when you need a particle effect for a hero or an animation and prefer to tune it by eye before taking it to your project.
uses: Creating a particle background for a landing page hero and exporting it as code.
Turning a logo or an image into an animated particle cloud.
Exporting the animation as a video or image to use on social media or in a presentation.
caveats: The AI doesn't live inside the tool: you generate the code in an external assistant and paste it to run it.
Custom code is filtered: it doesn't allow references such as document, window, fetch or eval.
Particles render on your GPU, so performance depends on your machine, especially with many particles or on mobile.
pricingNote: Free to use directly in the browser.
idealFor: Designers and developers who want to prototype 3D particles and export the code.
